concepts.def: Free-time vocab: escuchar música (listen to music), ver la tele (watch TV), salir con amigos (go out with friends).
Likes: me gusta + singular noun or infinitive, me gustan + plural: Me gustan las películas de acción.
Music vocab: el/la cantante (singer), la canción (song), el grupo (band), el concierto (concert).
Screen vocab: una película de terror (horror film), las noticias (the news), una serie (a series), la pantalla (screen).
Festivals: la Nochevieja (New Year's Eve) with las uvas de la suerte (lucky grapes), los Reyes Magos (Three Kings, 6 January).
Celebrity culture: famoso/a (famous), la fama (fame), una estrella (a star), las redes sociales (social media).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 2: Popular Culture — a core area of GCSE Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 2: Popular Culture brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 2: Popular Culture.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: 'Me gustan las películas de terror' means:
options: I like horror films.
I like the terror of films.
Horror films like me.
I liked a horror film.
Me gustan los conciertos.
Me gusta los conciertos.
Me gustan ir a conciertos.
Yo gusto los conciertos.
A dance
A song
A TV channel
A singer

mcqs.q: At which Spanish celebration do people traditionally eat twelve grapes at midnight?
options: La Tomatina
La Nochevieja (New Year's Eve)
La Semana Santa
Los Reyes Magos

mcqs.q: Why is 'Yo gusto el fútbol' wrong for 'I like football'?
options: To miss a concert.
It should be 'Yo gusto al fútbol' because gustar needs 'a'.
Because fútbol is a feminine noun.
Gustar works backwards — the thing liked is the subject: Me gusta el fútbol.

mcqs.q: What does describing a film as 'sensible' mean in Spanish?
options: Sensational and exciting.
Sensible and practical.
Sensitive or moving.
Because fútbol is a feminine noun.

mcqs.q: What does 'asistir a un concierto' mean?
options: To attend a concert.
To assist (help out) at a concert.
Sensational and exciting.
To miss a concert.
